The '''C fire team''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit that fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
C fire team fought in the [[Battle of Calamari]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. The unit was devastated by the onslaught of the [[World Devastator]]s. Their known actions included attempting to take out Devastators by attacking their towers. Towards the end of the battle, all known air support units had been wiped out by Imperial forces, including C fire team.
